title: ClearPath Tier Rates for Network and Server Order Cancellations
content:
The tier rate of an infrastructure cancellation, the fee percentage from which the fee on a Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order cancelled after its purchase order is figured, is **9.0 percent** when the client holds a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement whose status is active on the ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise tier, **12.0 percent** when that active agreement is on the ClearPath Standard or ClearPath Professional tier, and the order type's after-purchase-order cancellation fee percentage for every other client: 15 percent for a Network Equipment Order, 25 percent for a Server & Storage Build Order.

| Client's ClearPath position | Network Equipment Order | Server & Storage Build Order |
|---|---|---|
| Active, ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise | 9.0 percent | 9.0 percent |
| Active, ClearPath Standard or ClearPath Professional | 12.0 percent | 12.0 percent |
| Active, ClearPath Monitor or ClearPath Essentials | 15 percent | 25 percent |
| Agreement in any other status, or no agreement | 15 percent | 25 percent |

The tier and status are read from the client's ClearPath agreement record; a ClearPath Premier agreement that is closed or cancelled gives the order type's own percentage.
